prompts.label: Mon
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one finished square transparent calendar weekday icon based on the reference portrait of Twinkleping. Preserve the exact recognizable character identity, colors, face, hair, accessories and polished soft 3D toy render style. Redraw as a compact front-facing bust holding a wide pale ivory/lilac rounded plaque across the lower chest, physically part of the illustration. Exact text on plaque: "Mon" (three letters, exact case). The letters must be very large, bold rounded dark purple, simple and readable when this entire icon is only 44 pixels wide; lettering fills most plaque width and is at least 22% of total image height. Character head fills upper two thirds, plaque fills lower third, hands grip plaque edges. Incorporate one small crescent moon ornament into the plaque corner or the character's existing accessory, without covering text. One unified illustration, no separate floating caption or separate badge. Tight square composition filling 94% of canvas with small safe margin. Transparent background with clean alpha, no ground plane, no other text, no duplicate characters. Match a coordinated seven-icon weekday set with a consistent plaque size and lettering baseline.
